items.headline: Indian Stock Market Opens Lower Amid Global Cues and Oil Price Surge
items.summary: Indian equity markets opened lower with Nifty 50 down 0.56% and Sensex 30 down 0.70%, primarily due to elevated crude oil prices nearing $100 per barrel, a weakening rupee, and cautious global market sentiment stemming from geopolitical tensions.

items.headline: Brent Crude Nears $100 Per Barrel on US-Iran Tensions
items.summary: Brent crude futures climbed to around $99.3 per barrel and US WTI to $94.3, fueled by escalating US-Iran tensions and concerns over supply disruptions. This surge is negative for India, a major crude importer, risking wider trade deficits, rupee pressure, and domestic inflation.

items.headline: US Equities Decline on Oil Prices and Geopolitical Risks; Asian Markets Mixed
items.summary: US equities closed lower (S&P 500 down 0.58%, Dow Jones down 1.18%, Nasdaq down 0.32%) due to rising oil prices, geopolitical tensions, and inflation concerns. Asian markets showed mixed trends, with Japan's Nikkei 225 rising 0.3%, South Korea's Kospi gaining 2%, and Taiwan's benchmark advancing 0.6%, though overall sentiment was subdued.

items.headline: RBI Launches Inflation Expectations Survey and Conducts VRRR Auction
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India launched its September 2026 Household Inflation Expectations Survey to gather perceptions on price movements and inflation across 19 cities. The RBI also conducted an ₹500,000 crore overnight Variable Rate Reverse Repo (VRRR) auction to absorb surplus liquidity in the banking system.

items.headline: Rising Crude Prices Heighten Inflation Concerns for RBI
items.summary: Concerns about inflation are heightened as Brent crude prices approach $100 a barrel, posing risks to corporate margins and external accounts. Earlier, RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra indicated that India might consider lowering its long-term inflation target in the future, with retail inflation at 3.93% in May.

items.headline: Puravankara Reports Strong Q1 FY27 Earnings
items.summary: Puravankara reported a net profit of ₹29 crore with revenue jumping nearly 62% in Q1 FY27.

items.headline: Ashok Leyland Q1 Net Profit Rises 0.8%, Revenue Up 12%
items.summary: Ashok Leyland's Q1 FY27 net profit rose 0.8% to ₹616 crore, with revenue increasing by 12%.

items.headline: PhysicsWallah Narrows Q1 FY27 Net Loss as Revenue Increases
items.summary: PhysicsWallah's Q1 FY27 net loss narrowed to Rs 88 crore, while revenue increased by 24%.

items.headline: Engineers India Q1 Net Profit Surges 55% Supported by Robust Order Book
items.summary: Engineers India reported a 55% surge in Q1 FY27 net profit to ₹108.6 crore despite lower revenues, backed by a strong ₹14,424 crore order book.

items.headline: SPML Infra Reports Significant Q1 Net Profit and Revenue Growth
items.summary: SPML Infra reported an 87% net profit jump and 74% revenue growth to ₹286 crore in Q1 FY27.

items.headline: Bharat Dynamics Q1 Profit Soars 547%, Revenue Jumps 131%
items.summary: Bharat Dynamics' Q1 FY27 profit surged 547% year-on-year to ₹118.79 crore, with revenue jumping 131%.

items.headline: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Reports Revenue Growth but Profit Decline in Q1
items.summary: Associated Alcohols & Breweries' Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue grew 5.96% year-on-year to ₹286.30 crore, but net profit declined 24.60% to ₹17.83 crore due to raw material price inflation. The company announced a ₹2 per share final proposed dividend.

items.headline: IT and Banking Sectors Under Pressure; OMCs Face Margin Squeeze
items.summary: The IT sector was the worst performer, falling 2.40%, with Coforge and HCL Technologies seeing declines. The banking sector also remained under pressure. Oil-marketing companies (OMCs) like IOC, BPCL, and HPCL, along with paint, tyre, and aviation manufacturers, are expected to face margin pressure due to rising crude-linked input costs.

items.headline: Upstream Oil Producers and Metal Stocks See Buying Interest
items.summary: Upstream oil producers like ONGC and Oil India could benefit from higher crude prices. The S&P Industrial sector saw modest gains, and healthcare, consumer durables, and metal stocks also bucked the broader negative trend, showing some buying interest.

items.headline: Raymond Board Approves ₹214.71 Crore Fundraising via Warrants
items.summary: Raymond's board approved fundraising plans worth ₹214.71 crore through a preferential allotment of 33.28 lakh convertible warrants at an issue price of ₹645 per warrant to Minerva Ventures Fund.

items.headline: Bajaj Finance Allots Secured NCDs Worth ₹2,050 Crore
items.summary: Bajaj Finance allotted 2,05,000 secured NCDs worth Rs. 2,050.0271 crore at an 8.07% coupon.

items.headline: Piramal Finance to Issue ₹2,000 Crore Secured NCDs
items.summary: Piramal Finance's committee approved the issuance of up to ₹2,000 crore secured, rated, listed NCDs on a private placement basis at an 8.57% coupon.

items.headline: NLC India Subsidiary Bags 200 MW Wind Power Project Order
items.summary: NLC India Renewables Limited (NIRL), a wholly-owned subsidiary of NLC India, bagged a 200 MW wind power project order from SJVN.

items.headline: Adani Power Transfers 2,500 MW Renewable Power Contract to Adani Energy Solutions Subsidiary
items.summary: Adani Power assigned its 2,500 MW renewable energy round-the-clock power supply contract to Powerpulse Trading Solutions Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Adani Energy Solutions Limited.

items.headline: Bank of Baroda to Sell 35% Holding in NSE Through IPO Offer for Sale
items.summary: Bank of Baroda plans to sell up to 76.9 lakh NSE shares, representing 35% of its holding, through the NSE IPO Offer for Sale, expected to be completed by the end of September 2026.

items.headline: Bajaj Finance Acquires 5% Stake in TrueFan AI
items.summary: Bajaj Finance bought a 5% stake in TrueFan AI.

items.summary: Enviro Infra Engineers won a ₹189.99 crore EPC order from Tata Power Renewable Energy for an 180 MW wind project.

items.headline: Kesar Enterprises Approves ₹431 Crore Slump Sale of Sugar, Distillery, Cogen Units
items.summary: Kesar Enterprises approved a ₹431 crore slump sale of its sugar, distillery, and cogen units to Avadh Foods.

items.headline: Coforge Chairman Resigns Following Internal Audit Review
items.summary: Coforge Chairman O.P. Bhatt resigned with immediate effect on September 8 following concerns raised during an internal audit review of the board evaluation process. Vivek Sharma has been designated as interim Chairperson.

items.headline: Berger Paints Commences Commercial Production at New Facility in Andhra Pradesh
items.summary: Berger Paints commenced commercial production at its new solvent-based paint manufacturing facility in Hindupur, Andhra Pradesh.

items.headline: Signature Global to Launch Two Large Housing Projects in Gurugram
items.summary: The realty firm Signature Global plans to launch two large housing projects in Gurugram worth ₹10,000-12,000 crore during the second half of this fiscal year.

items.headline: Tata Communications' South Africa Subsidiary Dissolved
items.summary: Tata Communications' South Africa-based subsidiary, Kaleyra Africa, was dissolved.

items.headline: Laxmi Organic Industries MD & CEO Resigns as Part of Leadership Transition
items.summary: Laxmi Organic Industries MD & CEO Rajan Venkatesh resigned effective November 13, 2026, as part of a planned leadership transition, with Harshvardhan Goenka appointed as the new MD & CEO.

items.headline: Indian Hotels Company Ltd (IHCL) Signs New Ginger Property
items.summary: Indian Hotels Company Ltd (IHCL) signed a 111-key brownfield property under the Ginger brand in Nava Raipur.

items.headline: Hazoor Multi Projects Secures NHAI Contract for Fee Plaza Services
items.summary: Hazoor Multi Projects secured a ₹41.98 crore NHAI contract for fee plaza services.

items.headline: Innovision Bags Multiple NHAI Toll Collection and Six-Laning Contracts
items.summary: Innovision bagged multiple NHAI toll collection contracts worth ₹24.53 crore and ₹48.25 crore, and a ₹219.07 crore contract for a six-laning project.

items.headline: Moschip Technologies Directed to Provide Additional Security in Acquisition Dispute
items.summary: Supreme Court directed Moschip Technologies to provide ₹200 crore additional security in an ongoing acquisition dispute.

items.summary: Upstream producers like ONGC and Oil India could see benefits from higher crude prices, while OMCs (IOC, BPCL, HPCL) and paint, tyre, and aviation companies may face pressure due to rising crude prices.
